intro.text: That horn is the last ferry. The lighthouse is dark, and the fog is closing in. Let’s get the beacon working.
intro.speaker: harpreet

saveResume.text: The ferry is still out there. Let’s pick up where we left off.
saveResume.speaker: harpreet

notice.text: The chart shows one steady light for the inner harbour, two flashes for the deep channel, and three flashes for the shoals.
notice.speaker: harpreet

ticket.text: I heard the captain on the radio. They need the deep channel. The ferry is too big for the inner harbour.
ticket.speaker: kabir

repair.text: The old lens cracked in the storm. Take the spare from my workbench and fit it into the mount upstairs.
repair.speaker: meena

repaired.text: The lens is fitted. Now you can set the signal dial.
repaired.speaker: meena

foundLens.text: A spare lens. Let’s get it to the lantern room.
foundLens.speaker: harpreet

dead.text: The beacon needs a lens before I can set the signal.
dead.speaker: harpreet

unknown.text: I need both clues. The chart shows the signals, and Kabir knows where the ferry is headed.
unknown.speaker: harpreet

choose.text: The ferry needs the deep channel. Which signal marks it on the chart?
choose.speaker: harpreet

retry.text: That signal leads somewhere else. Check the flash pattern for the deep channel.
retry.speaker: harpreet

cantCombine.text: The spare lens belongs in the circular mount in the lantern room.
cantCombine.speaker: harpreet

ferrySafe.text: The captain sees our two flashes. The ferry is through the deep channel.
ferrySafe.speaker: meena

thanks.text: Look at all those lights on the water! I can see the ferry from here.
thanks.speaker: kabir
